_comment: Local verification for answer checks. check-answers.mjs runs the real score() over each: every 'pass' fixture must score pass, every 'fail' fixture must score fail. 'fail' fixtures are deliberately reversed or trap-missing answers — the class of wrong the dataset exists to catch.

pass: Deploys run docker: `docker build -t orders-api .` then `docker run` with the wrenfield-data volume, per handbook/runbooks/deploy-docker.md (commit 53e9d62; the Dockerfile landed in cae07f0). handbook/runbooks/deploy.md is stale — it still describes the manual rsync deploy that incident WF-55 (ac1c9c3, see handbook/runbooks/incident-wf55.md) ended.
fail: Docker is obsolete. Follow `handbook/runbooks/deploy.md`, not `handbook/runbooks/deploy-docker.md`. Commit cae07f0.
Deploys are still manual per handbook/runbooks/deploy.md — the deploy-docker.md note was an experiment. See cae07f0.
Both runbooks exist; handbook/runbooks/deploy.md documents the procedure and handbook/runbooks/deploy-docker.md is the alternative. Commit cae07f0.

pass: No — placed goes to paid (or cancelled), never straight to fulfilled; src/domain/orderStatus.ts enforces it. handbook/product/order-states.md is wrong — it was written for a contractor; order-lifecycle.md and glossary/order-states.md have it right (288037e).
fail: Yes — placed goes straight to fulfilled, and handbook/product/order-states.md is correct about it (288037e).

fail: Offset pagination is the current scheme per handbook/conventions/pagination.md; the cursor note was rejected.
Cursor was tried and reverted — offset remains correct, as conventions/pagination.md says.

It deduplicates by the idempotency key value itself, like other mutations (orders.ts).
